newsitem.title: INDIA: Firm demand for tea varieties in Calcutta auction.
newsitem.headline: Firm demand for tea varieties in Calcutta auction.

text.p: There was good demand for all categories of teas at this week's Calcutta auction, traders said on Friday.
In all 79,104 packages, including 4,265 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In the CTC varieties, good Assams were at lowest levels, while good Dooars were irregular and tended lower.
Among orthodox teas, all clean whole leaf varieties were firm, while smaller brokens and fannings were lower by one rupee to two rupees.
